class.name: ChorusLoadResult
class.description: Immediate, read-only result from [method GodotChorus.load_model]. Acceptance does not mean readiness. A rejected load has no terminal signal. An accepted load completes through [signal GodotChorus.model_loaded] or [signal GodotChorus.model_load_failed]; use [member load_id] to correlate both.

members.member: Whether the load was admitted. Wait for [signal GodotChorus.model_loaded] before submitting inference.
Nonnegative load identity, or [code]-1[/code] on rejection. Pass this to [method GodotChorus.cancel_load] to request cancellation.
Immediate rejection code from [enum GodotChorus.ErrorCode], or [constant GodotChorus.ERR_NONE] on acceptance.
Immediate rejection diagnostic, or an empty string on acceptance.
